note: Paths under benchmarks/results/ are run write targets; that directory is not tracked, so any predecessor artifact named here is unpublished history recorded for provenance, not a file in this repository.
purpose: Complete only the deployment, base-versus-fused evaluation, persistence, fresh-process reload, identity, and cleanup measurements that stopped V2 left unobserved. This draft does not authorize a server launch.

root_cause.verdict: The unexpected ID was ambient cache discovery. It was not a static alias and was not the model loaded at V2 startup or named by Imp requests; it is a genuine alternate model that MLX-LM could hot-load only if a request explicitly named it.

models_endpoint.behavior: handle_models_request scans huggingface_hub's active cache, advertises every model repository whose main ref has config.json, model.safetensors.index.json, and tokenizer_config.json, then appends the resolved CLI --model local path.

loaded_and_routed_identity.startup: ModelProvider maps default_model to the exact CLI --model path and ResponseGenerator loads it before handling generation work.
loaded_and_routed_identity.request: MLXLMDeployment sets both ReqLLM model.id and model.model to the exact fused path; ReqLLM's OpenAI Chat API encodes request.options.model into the JSON model field.
loaded_and_routed_identity.server: MLX-LM takes the JSON model field as requested_model and loads that exact key; the response model field echoes requested_model.
loaded_and_routed_identity.conclusion: The exact fused path is provably the sole startup-loaded artifact and sole routed artifact for an exact-path Imp request. The ambient cached model remains separately servable only under a different explicit request identity.

v2_launch.known_limit: ExternalCommand captured bounded server output in memory but discarded it during successful cleanup; the stopped result retains only the returned model IDs. The complete inherited launch environment and server log therefore remain unknown.

deployment_isolation.reason: Keep MLX-LM's ambient cache-discovery endpoint truthful without changing Imp's exact-single-ID guard or deleting/moving another user's cached model.
preconditions: the isolation root does not exist before launch
the runner creates only empty cache directories before starting the base server
the complete non-secret environment variable names and the six values above are retained in the result
the same isolation environment is present in the parent and fresh BEAM processes and inherited by every MLX-LM server
no download, cache import, symlink, model copy, or request for an alternate model occurs
deployment_isolation.guard: The existing unmodified MLXLMDeployment ids == [artifact_path] check must pass. No implementation or test change may weaken it.

frozen_data.training_use: none; the retained fused artifact is immutable

schedule: verify the contract, stopped V2 result, retained job, manifest, base tree, fused tree, data, row identities, source bindings, free ports, and empty isolated cache

start the exact base path with pinned MLX-LM 0.31.3 under the isolated environment; require /v1/models to contain exactly the resolved base path; evaluate and durably record the frozen selection and untouched test rows

load the retained job and start the exact fused path through public MLXLMDeployment; rebind the ordinary program through TrainingJob.rebind with that deployment LM; require the unmodified exact-single-ID guard; evaluate and durably record the same rows
save the verified job and rebound program, stop every parent deployment, and require both ports free

start a fresh BEAM process under the same isolated environment, load the saved job and program, rebind through a newly supervised exact fused deployment, require exact identity again, and reproduce byte-identical fused predictions
stop every process, require both ports free, and write one immutable result
identity_receipts_per_request: the deployment artifact path and SHA-256
the ReqLLM request telemetry model.id and model.model
a source-bound assertion that ReqLLM encodes that exact ID into the JSON model field
the Imp response __imp_lm_metadata__.req_llm.model echoed by MLX-LM
finish reason, token usage, raw output, parsed route, expected route, and correctness
attribution_acceptance: base and fused requests and responses each identify only their exact resolved artifact path
the content-verified fused artifact differs from the pinned base artifact
at least one untouched-test prediction changes between base and fused
the saved job and program reproduce byte-identical fused test predictions in a fresh BEAM process
every supervised process and reserved port is cleaned up

only_v2_to_continuation_changes: reuse V2's already trained and fused verified artifact without any training or fusion
isolate MLX-LM's Hugging Face cache discovery so /v1/models describes only the exact local path passed to that server
persist base and fused evaluation rows immediately after each completed stage
unchanged: all Banking77 rows, identities, order, split boundaries, and digests
lifecycle attribution and fresh-process byte-identity checks
forbidden: training, fusion, adapter update, artifact repair, or V2 resume
model, data, row, prompt, envelope, metric, or threshold change
requesting jxm/gpt-oss-20b-base or any alternate model
deleting, moving, importing, or modifying the ambient Hugging Face cache
retry, substitution, provider call, paid spend, or result-informed adjustment

stop_rules: any contract, source, artifact, dataset, row-order, environment, port, or clean-tree receipt mismatch
the isolated cache is not empty before the first server or gains an unexpected model during execution
any /v1/models ID list other than the one exact resolved artifact path for that server
any request or response model identity other than the exact artifact path for that arm
any training, fusion, download, alternate-model, retry, substitution, or result-informed action
first owning server, inference, persistence, reload, identity, byte-reproduction, or cleanup failure

interpretation.positive_or_negative_scores: Report exactly as observed on the frozen one-model, one-task, one-split evaluation; selection remains report-only.
interpretation.unchanged_predictions: Lifecycle attribution remains incomplete, not proof that SFT is generally ineffective.
interpretation.failure: A stopped continuation is a deployment or measurement failure, not an optimizer loss.
claim_limits: This draft does not authorize launch.
The continuation can complete only V2's deployment/lifecycle and task-specific changed-behavior measurement from the already verified fused tree.
It cannot establish general held-out effectiveness, DSPy or BetterTogether parity, GRPO, production reliability, or BEAM-native superiority.
V1 and V2 remain permanently stopped and must not be resumed, overwritten, or reinterpreted.
